enable_language(C)
foreach(_mikktspace_file IN ITEMS mikktspace.c mikktspace.h)
    file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${_mikktspace_file}" _mikktspace_actual)
    if(_mikktspace_file STREQUAL "mikktspace.c")
        set(_mikktspace_expected "de87e74107df766ce68108801262bd8d53899414236b59810509a8fc2a51e288")
    else()
        set(_mikktspace_expected "17fc433894f24c73753d548086cc4d8c5c0379f4a6edfb98b5da243e4f0bc3d0")
    endif()
    if(NOT _mikktspace_actual STREQUAL _mikktspace_expected)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "MikkTSpace source hash mismatch: ${_mikktspace_file}")
    endif()
endforeach()
add_library(ludus_mikktspace STATIC mikktspace.c)
set_target_properties(ludus_mikktspace PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 EXPORT_NAME MikkTSpace POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(ludus_mikktspace SYSTEM PUBLIC "$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}>")
# The reference uses assert(3) only for internal invariants; keep it out of release semantics.
target_compile_definitions(ludus_mikktspace PRIVATE $<$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>:NDEBUG>)
if(NOT WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(ludus_mikktspace PRIVATE m)
endif()
install(TARGETS ludus_mikktspace EXPORT LudusTargets ARCHIVE DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}")
install(FILES LICENSE DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/Ludus/licenses" RENAME mikktspace-LICENSE.txt)
